description: Return type `param is T`. A `true` result narrows the argument to `T` at the call site.
A function with a type predicate, used to validate untyped data such as JSON.
TypeScript 5.5+ infers `x is T` for simple boolean functions, e.g. `filter((x) => x !== undefined)`.
Does not narrow types and also removes `0`, `''` and `false`.
